payload.title: Holocene Ice Window Size
payload.summary: This Jupyter notebook analyzes the size of ice windows during the Holocene epoch using paleoclimate data. It imports and processes datasets from the LiPD format, focusing on specific indices of interest within each dataset. The notebook employs various data visualization and analysis libraries to explore and visualize the data. The outputs include processed datasets and visualizations that illustrate the changes in ice window sizes over time.

section_blurbs.blurb: The notebook focuses on analyzing the size of ice windows during the Holocene epoch using datasets in the LiPD format. It involves loading data, specifying indices of interest, and visualizing the results using various scientific computing libraries.
